mechanism: object-internal counterfactual semantic tangent residual queried at every tied CR-FPL loop

representation.selection: single preregistered representation; no source-validation transform selection
representation.tangent_fit: independent least-squares affine fit for each object trajectory side
channels: absolute residual slope (deviation from tangent slope)

model.semantic_injection: query all three CSTR channels at the current predicted distance in every tied loop
model.zero_semantic: exactly recovers geometry-only CR-FPL under shared weights
